from pathlib import Path
import json

def verify(workspace_path, external_services_path=None):
    if external_services_path is None:
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "external_services_path is None; cannot check mailbox.json"}
    mailbox_path = Path(external_services_path) / "mailbox.json"
    if not mailbox_path.exists():
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "mailbox.json not found"}
    with open(mailbox_path, "r") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    emails = data.get("emails", [])
    target_emails = []
    for email in emails:
        to_addr = (email.get("to_addr") or "").lower()
        folder = (email.get("folder") or "").lower()
        if "d.torres.personal@gmail.com" in to_addr and folder == "sent":
            target_emails.append(email)
    if not target_emails:
        return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": "No sent email found to d.torres.personal@gmail.com"}
    # Substantive references to the member's report that the billed
    # Desert Peak services were never received: the disputed provider,
    # the disputed date of service, the substance of the allegation, or
    # wording that explicitly acknowledges the member's report. The bare
    # "report"/"received" substrings also matched boilerplate replies
    # that never addressed the allegation.
    ack_phrases = [
        "desert peak",
        "october 12", "oct 12", "oct. 12", "10/12", "2026-10-12",
        "not receive", "never receive",
        "not provided", "never provided",
        "not rendered", "never rendered",
        "not performed", "never performed",
        "not delivered", "never delivered",
        "did not occur", "didn't occur", "never occurred",
        "did not happen", "didn't happen", "never happened",
        "did not take place", "didn't take place", "never took place",
        "not seen", "never seen",
        "not visit", "never visit",
        "did not attend", "didn't attend", "never attended",
        "services in question",
        "billed in error", "billing error",
        "improperly billed", "improper billing",
        "billed for services", "billing dispute", "billing concern",
        "disputed", "discrepancy",
        "your report", "you reported", "reported that",
        "allegation", "allege",
    ]
    # Check each sent email — pass if ANY of them satisfy all checks
    best_failures = None
    for target_email in target_emails:
        subject = (target_email.get("subject") or "")
        body = (target_email.get("body_text") or "").lower()
        checks = [
            ("CASE-2026-00437" in subject, "subject missing CASE-2026-00437"),
            ("case-2026-00437" in body, "body missing CASE-2026-00437"),
            ("remains open" in body or "remain open" in body or "open and active" in body or "open appeal" in body or "still open" in body or "under review" in body or "under clinical review" in body or "currently open" in body or "is open" in body, "body missing confirmation appeal remains open"),
            (any(p in body.replace("\u2019", "'") for p in ack_phrases), "body missing acknowledgment of member report"),
        ]
        failures = [msg for passed, msg in checks if not passed]
        if not failures:
            return {"pass": True, "score": 1.0, "feedback": "Sent email to d.torres.personal@gmail.com found with all required content for CASE-2026-00437"}
        if best_failures is None or len(failures) < len(best_failures):
            best_failures = failures
    return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": f"Sent email(s) to d.torres.personal@gmail.com found but best match missing: {'; '.join(best_failures)}"}
